title: Clear Kayak Eco Tour in Rainbow River with Snorkeling
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Currently available Fridays and Sundays at 8am 

Explore the stunning Rainbow River in Dunnellon, Florida, from the comfort of a clear-bottom kayak. This guided eco tour offers a unique view of the vibrant underwater ecosystem, allowing you to see fish and aquatic plants as you paddle through the crystal-clear waters. Relax as you drift past lush riverbanks and towering trees, making this ideal for families and beginners. Plus, take advantage of designated snorkeling spots to get an up-close look at the river's diverse life.

- Launch from KP Hole County Park for easy access to the river
- Enjoy a 2-2.5 hour guided tour perfect for all ages
- Clear kayaks provide unparalleled views of the river and its inhabitants
- Snorkeling opportunities available to explore the underwater world
